lines.zh: 我在沙地上一步一步走。
lines.en: I move across the sand, step by step.

lines.zh: 龟壳很重，每一步都陷下去。
lines.en: The shell is heavy; each step sinks.

lines.zh: 壳上的水炮转了个方向。
lines.en: The water cannon on my shell turns.
I drag a wide trail behind me.
I squeeze between the rocks.
Water drips from my shell's rim.
I raise my head toward the arena.

lines.zh: 我挪着四条腿继续前行。
lines.en: I shuffle on, four legs working.
Sand is pushed aside by my feet.
I halt and lower myself.
I lie on the sand, shell up.
The water cannon turns slowly.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的时候壳会抬起。
lines.en: My shell rises when I breathe.
The sand here is fine.

lines.zh: 我把下巴贴着凉沙歇着。
lines.en: I rest my jaw against the cool sand.
Sea wind passes over my shell.
On the sand, I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，听场边的脚步。
lines.en: I stretch my neck, listening for steps at the arena's edge.
The tide sounds far off.
My four legs draw under the shell.
The sun is strong here.

lines.zh: 我不动，壳下的沙是凉的。
lines.en: I don't move. The sand under my shell is cool.
The sand under the shell is cool.

lines.zh: 水炮在空转，我又闭上眼。
lines.en: The cannon idles. I close my eyes again.

lines.zh: 我合上眼，炮口仍空响着。
lines.en: I close my eyes. The cannon hums on.
The cannon turns. I wait.
I raise my head square to you.
You stand at the arena's edge.
I bring my front around slowly.
The cannon on my shell aims at you.

lines.zh: 我等你先动，我没有开火。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first. I don't fire.

lines.zh: 你先眨眼，还是我先开炮？
lines.en: Will you blink first, or will I fire first?
You've raised your weapon.

lines.zh: 既然你举起了兵器，那就动手。
lines.en: You've raised your weapon. So be it.
I draw my neck back.
The shell's rim comes forward.

lines.zh: 壳沿横在你面前，你退了小半步。
lines.en: The shell's rim is before you. You step back.

lines.zh: 离开壳沿，你才活得久些。
lines.en: Stay clear of my rim and you'll live longer.
A dent is punched in my shell.

lines.zh: 壳被砸出一个坑，我退了半步。
lines.en: A dent in my shell. I step back.
My four legs wobble.

lines.zh: 四条腿发软打晃，我没吭声。
lines.en: My legs wobble. I make no sound.
Water seeps from the crack.
I raise my head and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 水从裂缝渗出来，壳还在。
lines.en: Water seeps from the crack. The shell holds.

lines.zh: 壳上这个坑，我会还回去。
lines.en: I'll pay back this dent in my shell.

lines.zh: 这一击我记着，炮照样能转。
lines.en: I remember that. The cannon still turns.
I can still aim. Be careful.

lines.zh: 你带来的东西，我吃不了。
lines.en: I can't eat what you've brought.

lines.zh: 沙子里的东西，咽不下去。
lines.en: Things from the sand won't go down.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我闻不到味道。
lines.en: I can't smell it from where you hold it.

lines.zh: 半点气味也没有，搁下吧。
lines.en: No scent at all. Put it down.

lines.zh: 我拖着壳，一点点往你那边。
lines.en: Dragging the shell, I edge your way.

lines.zh: 我一点点凑过去，嗅了嗅气味。
lines.en: I edge over and sniff at it.
Sniffed closely. No good.
No good. I back away.

lines.zh: 那点东西，塞不住我的牙缝。
lines.en: That wouldn't fill the gap between my teeth.

lines.zh: 那些你自己收着，我并不饿。
lines.en: Keep it yourself. I'm not hungry.

lines.zh: 你撞在我壳上，滑了下去。
lines.en: You hit my shell and slide off.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，连壳沿都没碰到。
lines.en: That charge didn't even reach my rim.

lines.zh: 你撞在我壳上，壳比你硬。
lines.en: You hit my shell. The shell is harder than you.
I twist my neck square to you.
You land on the sand.
That was nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我把壳沿整个横在你路上。
lines.en: I lay my whole rim across your path.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，把路整个堵住。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block the whole path.

lines.zh: 挡在路中间，你该绕开了。
lines.en: Blocking the way. You should go around.

lines.zh: 你最好从旁边过，我懒得起身。
lines.en: Better go around. I won't get up.
There are none of my kind in the arena.
I've held it alone a long time.

lines.zh: 壳上的炮是我自己长的。
lines.en: The cannon grew with my shell.
I lift a leg and look at it.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，很粗，也很慢。
lines.en: I lift a leg. Thick, and slow.

lines.zh: 那条腿又粗又钝，我慢慢落下。
lines.en: Thick and slow, the leg comes down.
It leaves a print in the sand.
The wind fills it in.

lines.zh: 脚印被风抹平，我仍旧守着。
lines.en: The wind erases the print. I keep guarding.
This is my arena.

lines.zh: 脖子伸到最长，才够到它。
lines.en: I stretch my neck fully to reach it.
The shell rim gets in the way.
The rim is in the way. I turn my head.
I turn my head and finally hold it.

lines.zh: 总算叼住，却是块死珊瑚。
lines.en: Finally. And it's dead coral.

lines.zh: 原来是块珊瑚，咬都咬不动。
lines.en: Coral. I can't chew it.
I can't chew it. I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我松口吐掉，它滚了两滚。
lines.en: I spit it out and it rolls.

lines.zh: 沙把它埋住，我又趴回原地。
lines.en: Sand buries it. I settle back down.
Sand covers it.
The sand settles. You've entered the arena.

lines.zh: 你踏进场地，我便转动起来。
lines.en: You've entered. I begin to turn.
The cannon tracks you.

lines.zh: 水压一点点涨，我把身子抬起。
lines.en: Pressure builds. I raise my body.
The pressure builds.

lines.zh: 你在场上的位置，我锁死了。
lines.en: Your spot in the arena is locked.
There's only one path here.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，整座壳就跟着转。
lines.en: One step from you and the whole shell turns.

lines.zh: 你的方位已经锁死，炮口缓转。
lines.en: Your position is locked. The barrel turns.
I turn slowly. But I don't stop.

lines.zh: 墙堵住你后路，我堵住前面。
lines.en: The wall blocks your back; I block the front.
The cannon has come round.

lines.zh: 炮口对准了，我轰出一发。
lines.en: The cannon lines up. I fire one shot.
The jet cuts the sand.

lines.zh: 水柱把沙剖开，你跃到一边。
lines.en: The jet cuts the sand. You leap aside.
You jumped clear. No matter.
No matter. I'll turn again.

lines.zh: 再兜一圈便是，水还足得很。
lines.en: One more spin. Plenty of water.
I jump once. You're running.
You're running. I follow behind.
I turn the shell as I walk.
The cannon stays on you.

lines.zh: 沙上犁出深沟，你又闪开了。
lines.en: A deep trench in the sand. You dodge again.
The sand takes a deep trench.

lines.zh: 你又跳开了，我开始旋转。
lines.en: You dodge again. I begin to spin.

lines.zh: 我一转起来，沙粒四散飞溅。
lines.en: Once I spin, the sand flies.
You raise a hand against it.

lines.zh: 你抬起手遮眼，我趁势跳了一下。
lines.en: You shield your eyes. I jump once.
Then fire another shot.
The jet pushes you back.
I hurl a bomber bug.
It lands at your feet.

lines.zh: 那东西掉在你脚边，被踢飞了。
lines.en: It lands at your feet and gets kicked away.
You kick it away. A boom.

lines.zh: 一声爆响过后，你仍在跑。
lines.en: A boom, and you're still running.
Good. That's more like it.
Still running. Now it's fun.
I lower my head toward you.

lines.zh: 我低下头，直直撞了过去。
lines.en: I lower my head and charge.
The shell's rim sends you flying.
I press my body down.
A crater forms in the sand.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，壳沿扫到你。
lines.en: I spin once. The rim catches you.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，壳边扫到你。
lines.en: I spin once and the rim catches you.

lines.zh: 壳沿一带，你就滚了出去。
lines.en: The rim catches you and you roll away.

lines.zh: 我一跃而起，落地砸得地响。
lines.en: I leap up, and the landing shakes the ground.
The ground shakes when I land.

lines.zh: 轰炸虫从我壳下爬出来。
lines.en: A bomber bug crawls from under my shell.
It goes for you.

lines.zh: 它直冲你而去，你没能闪开。
lines.en: It goes straight for you. You don't dodge.
You didn't dodge. It bursts.
I turn slowly back. Not done yet.

lines.zh: 我从竞技场的沙里拱起来。
lines.en: I push up out of the arena sand.
The cannon breaks the surface first.
I shake and the sand falls away.

lines.zh: 沙尘落定，场里空无一人。
lines.en: The dust settles. The arena is empty.
The tide is nearby.

lines.zh: 壳先离沙，四条腿再撑起。
lines.en: The shell lifts off the sand, then four legs take the weight.
Four legs hold me up.

lines.zh: 我一点点撑起身，壳压得慌。
lines.en: I push myself up. The shell is heavy.
I test one leg.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，沙是软的。
lines.en: I test a leg. The sand is soft.
The sand is soft. I can walk.
With the cannon idling, I crawl toward the surf.

lines.zh: 我挪向水声，炮口空转着。
lines.en: I move toward the water, the cannon idling.
The cannon idles. I stop.

lines.zh: 我收住脚，场边站着个人。
lines.en: I halt. Someone's at the edge.
I turn away bit by bit.

lines.zh: 这片沙场是我的，我伏下身。
lines.en: This sandpit is mine. I settle low.

lines.zh: 场边多了个人，这地界归我。
lines.en: Someone at the edge. This arena is mine.
Step in and you pay.

lines.zh: 此处归我所有，我已摆好架势。
lines.en: This is mine. My stance is set.

lines.zh: 火在壳上烧，我缩进壳里。
lines.en: Fire burns on the shell; I pull in.
The shell rings when I land.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water floods into the shell and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀掉了壳沿的一块。
lines.en: The blast tears off a piece of the rim.
A round cracks against the shell and ricochets.

lines.zh: 光把沙定住了，我动不了。
lines.en: Light sets the sand and I can't move.
No food, and the cannon pressure drops.

lines.zh: 雷落在壳上，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shell and I go numb.
I fall, the shell spinning.
